BrochureContent.Content:
Mark Kelly & Associates are delighted to present 42 Hunters Walk to the market. This superb extended three-bedroom, three-bathroom terrace home with study is ideally positioned overlooking a large open green area to the front and boasts a beautifully landscaped tiered south-facing rear garden. Built in 2003 and thoughtfully enhanced by the current owners, the property benefits from a substantial rear extension added in 2013, creating spacious and versatile living accommodation ideally suited to modern family life. Presented in excellent condition throughout and located within the highly sought-after Hunterswood development, this exceptional home is sure to appeal to a broad range of purchasers including first-time buyers, young families, downsizers and investors alike.

No. 42 briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall with guest WC and useful understairs storage. To the front is a fitted kitchen overlooking the open green area, while to the rear a spacious living and dining room flows seamlessly into the extended family room, added by the current owners in 2013, with direct access to the beautifully landscaped south-facing rear garden.

Upstairs, the first floor comprises two generous double bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and a large family bathroom. The second floor is completed by an impressive principal bedroom with en-suite together with a separate study/home office, which may offer potential for conversion to a fourth bedroom, subject to the necessary planning permission, with similar conversions evident throughout the development.
Built in 2003, Hunterswood is nestled at the foothills of the Dublin Mountains, offering the perfect balance of scenic surroundings and everyday convenience. The development features a créche, playground, and beautifully maintained communal green spaces. A wide range of amenities are close at hand, including Lidl Ballycullen, Woodstown Village, SuperValu Firhouse/Knocklyon, Tesco White Pines, and the renowned Dundrum Town Centre, all just a short drive away. For those who enjoy the outdoors, there is an abundance of recreational options nearby such as Marlay Park, Tymon Park, Ballycragh Park, the Hell Fire Club, Bohernabreena Reservoir, and a host of mountain walking trails. Connectivity is another standout feature, with the M50 (Firhouse exit) only minutes away. Public transport links are excellent, with the 15 (24-hour service) and 15B bus routes terminating just outside the estate, and additional services including the 49, S8, 65B, and the 175 to UCD all within easy walking distance.

ACCOMMODATION

Ground Floor
Entrance Hall: (1.87m x 4.68m) Bright and welcoming entrance hall featuring dark oak-effect laminate flooring, a carpeted staircase to the upper floors and convenient understairs storage, providing access to the guest WC/utility area, kitchen/dining room and living room.

Guest WC / Utility: (0.86m x 1.45m) Comprising WC, WHB, overhead storage and utility area, plumbed for washing machine and dryer.

Kitchen (2.20m x 5.88m) Bright front-facing kitchen and dining area with bay window overlooking the open green area to the front. Featuring cream tiled flooring, the fully fitted kitchen comprises a range of floor and eye-level units together with integrated appliances including a Zanussi fridge freezer, Gorenje oven and extractor hood. The kitchen is plumbed for a dishwasher and washing machine and also houses the gas-fired central heating boiler.

Dining Room: (4.27m x 3.13m) Spacious reception room featuring dark oak-effect laminate flooring, feature fireplace and double doors opening to the family room.

Living Room: 3.92m x 4.39m Impressive full-width rear extension added by the current owners in 2013, flooded with natural light and featuring dark oak-effect laminate flooring throughout. This exceptional additional living space provides direct access to the private south-facing rear garden and is ideal for modern family living and entertaining.

First Floor
Landing: (1.87m x 5.17m) Carpeted landing providing access to the first-floor accommodation.

Bedroom 1: (4.27m x 3.13m) Spacious double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, overlooking the rear garden.

Bedroom 2: (2.33m x 3.56m) Well-proportioned bedroom overlooking the front of the property and the attractive open green area beyond.

Family Bathroom: (2.19m x 2.12m) Fully appointed family bathroom comprising bath with shower attachment, WC and wash hand basin.

Second Floor
Landing: (1.83m x 1.13m) Carpeted landing providing access to the principal bedroom and study.

Principal Bedroom: (4.27m x 2.81m) Generous double bedroom featuring extensive built-in wardrobes and a private en-suite bathroom.

En Suite Bathroom: (2.34m x 1.05m) Fully tiled suite comprising shower enclosure, WC and wash hand basin.

Study / Office: (3.31m x 4.10m) Versatile room currently in use as a home office, complete with built-in wardrobes and a Velux window. The space may offer potential for conversion to a fourth bedroom, subject to the necessary planning permission. 

Rear Garden:
Beautifully landscaped and private south-facing tiered rear garden, upgraded by the current owners and designed for low-maintenance living. Comprising a patio area, artificial lawn, raised upper level and garden shed, it provides an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertaining.

Front Garden:
The property enjoys an attractive low-maintenance cobblelock frontage with mature shrubbery and an open green area directly opposite, creating a pleasant outlook and ideal recreational space for young families. Ample communal and visitor parking is available to the front, with communal bin storage conveniently located within the development.
